_about: Segments of the Fortune, Fate, Loot, Chaos and Boss wheels (SPEC.md › Wheels and randomness). Weights are data; every amount comes from balance.json (the `effect` names the rule and packages/shared/handlers/wheels.js reads the number). Chaos segments carry a minTier: they are on the wheel only once state.chaos.tier has reached it, which is how the legacy tiers (Reshuffle → Repaint → Upheaval → Scatter → Apocalypse) escalate. The Boss wheel has no fixed segments: it spins over the boss species' moods table in data/monsters.json. The Buy-in wheel is built in run.js from health.buyinMin/buyinMax. The Bug Reward Wheel (bugreward) is spun by the GM for a player who reported a bug (GM_BUG_REWARD).

fortune.label: A Gift
fortune.text: An item rolled on the Loot Wheel's rarity.

fate.label: Trapdoor
fate.text: Dropped onto a random hex in another region. The hex does not resolve.

fate.label: Switcheroo
fate.text: Swap places with a random living player (never an Enforcer).

fate.label: Found Property
fate.text: A free item at Loot Wheel rarity.

fate.label: Wanted
fate.text: The house posts gold.perKO on your head.

loot.label: Item
loot.text: An item; rarity from the four loot weights, shifted by Luck and region.

loot.label: Gold
loot.text: gold.chestGold plus gold.chestGoldPerTier per region tier.

loot.label: Egg
loot.text: A pet egg of the region.

chaos.label: The Collector
chaos.text: The hooded ledger-keeper takes chaos.collectorTakes Health from the spinner.

chaos.label: Blood in the Water
chaos.text: Damage ×chaos.regionMult in the spinner's region for wheels.chaosRegionRounds rounds.

chaos.label: Marked Class
chaos.text: One class at the table takes ×chaos.classMult for wheels.chaosClassRounds rounds.

chaos.label: Shuffle the Cage
chaos.text: The spinner's grid is scrambled (inventory module).

chaos.label: Mercy
chaos.text: The wheel spares you. This time.

chaos.label: Scapegoat
chaos.text: The table votes a victim; the Collector visits them.

chaos.label: Tighten the Bars
chaos.text: The spinner's grid loses a row for wheels.chaosGridShrinkRounds rounds (inventory module).

chaos.label: Sticky Fingers
chaos.text: A random grid cell of the spinner is stolen by the house (inventory module).

chaos.label: Escalation
chaos.text: Chaos rises a tier at once.

chaos.label: Scatter
chaos.text: Every living character is thrown to a random hex of their region.

chaos.label: Apocalypse
chaos.text: Everyone takes the Collector's cut, every region bleeds, and the tier is pinned at max.

bugreward.label: A Rare Find
bugreward.text: A Rare item rolled for your region, straight into the grid.

bugreward.label: Epic Thanks
bugreward.text: An Epic item rolled for your region, straight into the grid.

bugreward.label: The House Owes You
bugreward.text: A Legendary (an Epic if the run's Legendary has already dropped).

bugreward.label: Patched Up
bugreward.text: Full Health and +wheels.bugMaxHealth max Health for the run.

bugreward.label: Sharper
bugreward.text: +1 stat point to spend on Self.

bugreward.label: Something Hatching
bugreward.text: A pet egg of your region.
